items.rationale: Accept easy. Gară, Aeroport and Stație are places where transport stops; Vapor is a vehicle. The player can name the common relation from the visible words. All four are travel concepts, avoiding a subject jump or grammatical shortcut; a ship visiting a port does not turn the ship into a stopping facility. Four fresh Intrusul words and no old-board overlap.

Accept easy. Eating, drinking and cooking form a clear food-related action trio; reading does not have that lexical purpose. The label explicitly covers both preparation and consumption, so cooking is not forced into an eating-only category. All four are infinitives, and reading a recipe is only incidental context. Four fresh words and no competing equally precise trio.

Accept easy. Wind, cloud and fog describe weather; night describes a time of day. Night can be windy or foggy, so darkness is not an alternative atmospheric answer. These are common words with a clear contrast, not technical cloud taxonomy. All four are new in this game; no old trio is recycled.

Accept easy. Banana, orange and lemon are familiar fruits; carrot is the ordinary edible root. The two citrus fruits do not form an alternative group of three, and the label does not require sweetness. Banana is a useful small variation inside an accessible group. Three new game words; only carrot overlaps old stock.

Accept easy. Grape/raisin, earth/shovel, pavement/street and neck/head are immediately nameable food-transformation, tool/material, street-part and body-part associations. Earth/street or shovel/pavement are conceivable construction context, but do not provide another equally specific complete matching. All intended pairs are new; native pair enumeration has exactly one solution. The earth label correctly says moving material rather than claiming earth is itself a location.

Accept easy. Biscuit/crumb, chair/stool, week/weekend and soup/bowl give four different concrete relationships. Putting biscuits in a bowl cannot complete a persuasive alternative: soup/crumb would need an unshown crouton or bread assumption. Chair/stool contrasts the absence of a back, without claiming all chairs have arms. Ordinary words and four new pairs; no native unintended link or competing complete matching.

Accept easy. Night/sleep, fridge/freezer, mouth/lip and garment/lint are clear time/activity, appliance, body-part and material-fragment anchors. The timing wording allows daytime sleep and avoids an absolute biological claim. A mouth consumes refrigerated food only through an extra unshown ingredient, leaving the remaining terms unmatched. Four fresh intended pairs and exactly one strong-edge matching.

Accept easy. Garden/rake, carpet/vacuum, mother/baby and wolf/forest are familiar functional, care and habitat relations. Raking forest leaves is possible but swaps away the more specific garden/tool relation and leaves wolf/garden as an incidental occurrence. Vacuuming garden debris likewise does not make another sensible complete partition. The habitat label is explicitly nonexclusive; all four links are new and each is supported by the native graph.
